sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Cash register TAR2-2 is a Loot Container in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Description
sections.text: Bigger than the standard Cash register, has a 2x2 grid that spawns stacks of Roubles. The locked ones located in the IDEA, OLI and Goshan stores at the ULTRA shopping mall on Interchange can also spawn Physical Bitcoins.
